basic.name: Surging Fist
basic.description: Activate to begin charging Surging Fist. Activate again to dash forward, knocking aside enemies and dealing 46~~0.04~~ damage. The dash range increases by up to 250%, depending on how long it is charged.

basic.name: Consuming Blaze
basic.description: Ignite nearby enemies, dealing 150~~0.04~~ damage over 5 seconds. Basic Attacking burning enemies re-Ignites them. Cho is healed for 40~~0.04~~ when an enemy is Ignited.

basic.name: Rune Bomb
basic.description: Roll a bomb dealing 91~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in its path. Gall can use Runic Blast to detonate it to deal 210~~0.04~~ damage in an area.

basic.name: Surging Fist
basic.description: Activate again to dash forward, knocking aside enemies and dealing 46~~0.04~~ damage. The dash range increases by up to 250%, depending on how long it is charged.

heroic.name: Upheaval
heroic.description: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: Hammer of Twilight
heroic.description:
Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150~~0.045~~ damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

Passive: Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.

trait.name: Ogre Hide
trait.description: Activate to gain 25 Armor, but reduce Gall's damage by 25%.

trait.name: Ogre Hide
trait.description:
Cho's Armor is increased by 25, but Gall's damage is reduced by 25%.

Gall can activate Ogre Rage to grant himself 25% increased damage, but remove this Armor bonus.

activable.name: Hearthstone
activable.description: Teleports you back to the Altar, instantly restoring you to full Health.

activable.name: Molten Block
activable.description: Activate to enter Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds, damaging nearby enemies for 92~~0.04~~ damage per second.

activable.name: Twilight Veil
activable.description: Activate to increase the Armor bonus of Ogre Hide to 75 for 4 seconds. If cast while Ogre Rage is active, it instantly swaps to Ogre Hide.

level1.name: Consuming Fire
level1.description: Consuming Blaze restores 75~~0.04~~ more Health when a Hero is Ignited.

level1.name: Calloused Hide
level1.description: While under 50% maximum Health, Cho gains 15% increased Movement Speed and healing received.

level1.name: The Will of Cho
level1.description:
Quest: Killing enemy Minions grants 1 stack of The Will of Cho, and Hero takedowns grant 10 stacks. Gain 1 Armor for every 30 stacks of The Will of Cho, up to a maximum of 10 Armor.

This Armor bonus stacks with Ogre Hide.

level4.name: Uppercut
level4.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Surging Fist deals additional damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their max Health and reduces the cooldown of Surging Fist by 5 seconds.

level4.name: Rollback
level4.description: Rune Bomb rolls back to Cho, damaging enemies in its path.

level4.name: Seared Flesh
level4.description: Each consecutive Basic Attack to enemy Heroes deals 20% more damage, to a maximum of 60% damage. This bonus lasts 5 seconds or until a non-Heroic enemy is attacked.

level7.name: Power Surge
level7.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Surging Fist are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Gain 15% Movement Speed while charging Surging Fist and for 2.5 seconds after casting the Ability.

level7.name: Firestarter
level7.description:
Basic Attacks against ignited Heroes decreases the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 1.5 second.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 3 seconds.

level7.name: Enraged Regeneration
level7.description: Each time Cho hits an enemy Hero with an Ability or Basic Attack, he heals for 60~~0.04~~ over 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Gall's Dread Orb receive 35% less healing for 2 seconds.

level16.name: Runic Feedback
level16.description: Gall's Runic Blast reduces Cho's Rune Bomb cooldown by 1 second per enemy hit, and 2 seconds for each Hero hit.
